platform: Rust + Tauri v2 / Windows 10+ (primary desktop client); optional Electron / Windows x64 setup wizard; .NET 8 / WPF (legacy), Python/Tkinter macOS companion (legacy), static GitHub Pages website with a CSS-only backdrop

features.name: Experimental legacy FPS target request
features.status: Experimental legacy / opt-in / may be ignored
features.details: The Tauri/Electron desktop profile keeps DFIntTaskSchedulerTargetFps off by default and writes it only after explicit opt-in, separately from the canonical 18-key allowlist. The request is clamped to 60-1000 FPS, backed up, and removed by Restore. Current Roblox clients may ignore or cap it; no FPS gain or unlock is guaranteed. The saved request is not actual FPS; use Roblox Performance Stats (Shift+F5) for live in-game FPS and game-server ping.

features.name: Texture and cache alterations
features.details: Provides texture tiers 0-3 through the allowlisted texture override, plus a conservative cleaner for old Roblox/Roptimer log and temporary files. It does not perform aggressive in-memory cache garbage collection or touch game assets.

features.name: Disable Roblox telemetry / Crashpad / Backtrace / screenshots
features.details: Hidden diagnostic and abuse-reporting flags are not on the local allowlist and are not written. Marktis Optimizer sends no analytics of its own; its optional website TCP connection check runs only when requested. It does not disable Roblox diagnostics, crash handlers, or background screenshot/reporting systems.

features.name: Extended graphic tiers
features.details: Exposes quality values 0-21 through the allowlisted FRM quality override. Values above 10 use legacy/micro levels and may look different or be ignored as Roblox changes the client.

features.name: Better FPS / optimization modes
features.details: Maximum performance lowers selected graphics/texture and geometry detail, Balanced provides a middle ground, and High quality retains more detail. Presets stage local allowlisted settings; they cannot guarantee lag-free play or increase hardware limits. Any legacy FPS target remains a separate experimental opt-in and may be ignored.

features.name: Reduce building lag
features.details: Reduces geometry LOD distance, grass distance, textures, MSAA and motion. It does not remove buildings, change collision, or alter gameplay geometry.

features.name: Session detection
features.details: The V4 Windows client reports whether RobloxPlayerBeta.exe appears in the OS process list using the process image name only; its Player card also shows an approximate stopwatch from the app's first observation, not an exact process launch or game-session duration. It does not read command-line arguments, game titles, thumbnails, server IDs/addresses, account data, player lists, chat, or memory. The legacy .NET Session page also displays local process paths and window titles.

features.name: Safe bootstrapper / CLI
features.details: RoptimerBoost.exe and Roptimer Boost.command can preview, apply, restore, inspect a session, clean old cache files, print the canonical FastFlag allowlist, launch Roblox through its normal URL scheme, and open the desktop app. Neither injects a DLL.

features.name: DLL injector / process hooks
features.details: No process injection, DLL loading, renderer hooks, memory patching, or executable modification, even when described as optimization only.

features.name: Fullbright / x-ray / building removal
features.details: No exploit-style visuals, world lighting changes, transparent walls, collision edits, or building deletion.

features.name: C# .NET 8 WPF app
features.details: Legacy dependency-free WPF desktop client with a local-settings-only bootstrapper. The current Rust + Tauri and Electron releases are the primary desktop apps and use a separate Marktis Optimizer interface.

features.name: Settings tab
features.details: Interactive website settings builder for optimization mode, FPS target, graphics tier 0-21, texture tier 0-3, cache age, generated Windows/macOS CLI commands, and the embedded FastFlag allowlist docs section.

features.name: Marktis standalone desktop interface
features.details: The primary Rust + Tauri and optional Electron clients use a purpose-built Marktis desktop interface, separate from the website. Users can customize local accent colors and select bundled anime background themes.

features.name: Windows EXE build
features.details: GitHub Actions builds Roptimer.exe and RoptimerBoost.exe on windows-latest. RoptimerBoost.exe open launches the desktop app; bootstrap applies safe settings first.

features.name: macOS companion downloads
features.details: Adds an unsigned Python/Tkinter macOS package with .command launchers, a .app terminal launcher, Mac path discovery for /Applications/Roblox.app/Contents/MacOS/ClientSettings, CLI parity, canonical allowlist files, docs, and a macOS build workflow.

features.name: Lightweight Sirius-style CSS-only website
features.details: The lightweight portal has five main tabs: Client, How it works, Allowlist, Downloads, and Docs. It uses a static CSS starfield, frame-throttled scroll progress, lazy screenshot images, and no WebGL/Three.js runtime, full-screen ambient overlay, tab-switch fade, or per-flag reveal animation. All website scripts and styles are local.

features.name: CLI and how-it-works docs
features.details: Adds a complete CLI reference, performance guide, canonical FastFlag allowlist guide, local JSON/backup explanation, macOS setup guide, and GitHub Pages help. The new How it works tab explains the Windows ClientAppSettings.json path, allowlisted key/value format, backup/merge/restore flow, and what the website builder can and cannot change; full markdown guides remain downloadable.

features.name: Marktis Optimizer Script Hub
features.details: Original Luau-inspired local UI recipe catalog with code cards, eight screenshots, a Run preview button, and command-palette actions. It is not a Roblox executor and never sends code to a game.

features.name: GUI loading script preview
features.details: A local HTML/CSS/JavaScript loading GUI preview with steps, progress bar, and Sirius/Rayfield-like menu styling. No loadstring, game services, remote code, or executor APIs.

features.name: GitHub Pages Actions deployment
features.details: A deploy-pages.yml workflow regenerates screenshots and HTML, validates local links, checks the current Pages build type, and deploys web/ with actions/deploy-pages@v4 when source is GitHub Actions. If source stays legacy, it skips deployment and the committed root index.html fallback serves the site instead of README.md.

features.name: Root fallback + website validator
features.details: build_website.py now generates web/index.html, a root index.html fallback, .nojekyll, 404 pages, site.webmanifest, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and embeds both the feature catalog and canonical FastFlag allowlist. Its --check mode validates placeholders, local references, JSON, manifest, and allowlist output.

features.name: Searchable command palette
features.details: Ctrl/Cmd+K or / opens a keyboard-navigable palette with 13 actions for tabs, generated CLI commands, downloads, releases, the FastFlag allowlist, safety docs, low-motion focus mode, and the local Script Hub preview. No dynamic code execution.

features.name: Lightweight CSS starfield and visual effects
features.details: Uses a static CSS starfield and gradient backdrop, modest tab/reveal/counter interactions, and an optional low-motion focus mode. No canvas rendering loop, WebGL, GPU bloom, or cursor-follow spotlight.

features.name: Canonical FastFlag allowlist
features.details: Adds fastflags-allowlist.json as the single source of truth for 18 Roblox local ClientAppSettings.json flags in Geometry, Rendering, and User Interface categories. Python and .NET load/validate the same list, the CLI exposes it with --allowlist/allowlist, the website Docs tab renders it, and the WPF app has a dedicated Allowlist page. The legacy FPS flag is explicitly excluded, and telemetry/exploit/anti-cheat flags are rejected.

features.name: Roblox game script executor / exploit loader
features.details: No game script execution, loadstring, executor API, remote script hub, process attachment, or anti-cheat bypass. The Script Hub is strictly a local UI/documentation preview.

features.name: Rust + Tauri v2 standalone Windows client
features.details: Guided x64 NSIS setup wizard for the primary Marktis Optimizer Rust + Tauri Windows client. It uses WebView2, has a distinct Main and grouped Settings UI, detects Roblox locally, manages canonical allowlisted settings by default, and shows read-only hardware details. Main includes the read-only Version Garden and Tuning Lab, a manual-only Benchmark Storyboard, an in-app Quick Action Tray, and offline troubleshooting. It also offers fixed roblox:// launch, confirmed Apply & launch, safe rendering presets, and an opt-in experimental legacy FPS request. The Icons tab bundles local anime backgrounds; actual game FPS and experience ping are never read.

features.name: Roblox detection on first launch
features.details: The Windows client detects standard Roblox installation/version folders and ClientSettings paths (read-only, OS-level), distinguishing Player and Studio. Detection itself does not launch Roblox. A separate user-triggered launcher dispatches the fixed roblox:// protocol through Windows Explorer. Apply & launch requires confirmation and runs only after a successful settings write.

features.name: Windows-only standalone desktop settings manager
features.details: The website has a Client tab; the standalone Rust + Tauri app has a Main page plus grouped Settings sections for Rendering, Geometry, Icons, and Allowlist. The settings manager is Windows-only; the macOS companion is a separate legacy tool.

features.name: Allowlist features: what each flag improves
features.details: The canonical allowlist includes categoryDescriptions and per-flag feature descriptions for all 18 Geometry, Rendering, and User Interface flags. The website and the standalone desktop Allowlist section show searchable flag names and improvement descriptions.

features.name: Three.js / WebGL website scene
features.details: Removed from the website to reduce rendering load. The site no longer ships or imports Three.js, a WebGL canvas, or a 3D scene; lightweight CSS gradients and static stars remain.

features.name: Rust safe apply/restore with backups
features.flag: 18 canonical allowlisted keys + opt-in legacy FPS key
features.details: Rust writes canonical allowlisted ClientAppSettings.json keys by default, preserves unrelated keys, and creates timestamped backups. The experimental legacy FPS target is a separate opt-in and is removed by Restore; it may be ignored by Roblox.

features.name: Allowlisted rendering API preference
features.details: The standalone Windows app selects System default, Direct3D 11, Vulkan, or OpenGL using only the mutually exclusive canonical allowlisted switches. Direct3D 12 is not included in the allowlist; unsupported renderer flags are never written.

features.name: Local known-executor process-name check
features.details: At startup, every 30 seconds while open, and on request, the Windows app checks exact process image names Xeno.exe, Solara.exe, JJSploit.exe, and Delta.exe. Alerts stay on-device/in-app; only the image-name field is parsed. Any PID present in tasklist temporary output is ignored and not retained or reported; no paths, command lines, process memory, or network data are collected by this scan. This is not antivirus or a complete malware scan. Matches lead to Windows Settings/Windows Security for user review; no process is terminated and no files/software are deleted automatically.

features.name: Dynamic in-game resolution scaling
features.details: Not implemented. The canonical Roblox allowlist has no supported runtime render-scale control. Monitoring game-frame/GPU conditions and changing internal render resolution would cross the app’s no-process-inspection/no-hook boundary. Use Roblox’s official graphics controls instead.

features.name: Force Roblox onto selected CPU cores
features.details: Not implemented. Setting per-process P-core/E-core affinity requires opening and changing the Roblox process, which is outside the local allowlisted-settings boundary. Windows and Roblox retain control of CPU scheduling.

features.name: ExitLag-style route optimization / jitter mitigation
features.details: ExitLag-style Roblox route optimization is not implemented. The Rust + Tauri and Electron Windows desktop apps separately include a user-controlled WireGuard integration that follows only a user/provider-supplied .conf profile; this changes Windows routes only after confirmation and administrator approval, provides no VPN server or credentials, and cannot guarantee lower ping. The static website, legacy .NET app, and macOS companion do not provide this integration. The optional website TCP measurement is not a game-server route optimizer.

features.name: Fixed-protocol Roblox desktop launcher
features.details: The Tauri and Electron Main pages can ask Windows Explorer to dispatch the fixed roblox:// URI. Apply & launch requires confirmation and launches only after settings are successfully written. No shell command, arbitrary URL, game join, injection, or process manipulation is performed.

features.name: Read-only Roblox Version Garden
features.details: The shared Tauri/Electron Main page lists detected standard Roblox version folders, Player/Studio presence, and whether ClientAppSettings.json exists, including its detected or expected local path. The view checks file presence only and does not read setting values or modify files.

features.name: Tuning Lab side-by-side profile comparison
features.details: The desktop Tuning Lab compares two saved profiles or the current staged profile, highlights differing supported values, and lets the user stage a saved profile for review. Comparison makes no settings or profile writes; writing Roblox settings still requires the usual explicit Apply confirmation.

features.name: Manual Benchmark Storyboard
features.details: Charts FPS and experience-ping comparisons entered by the user from Roblox Shift+F5. Values are stored in the existing local benchmark journal; the app does not read live game values, fabricate results, or guarantee improvements.

features.name: Windows and in-app Quick Action Tray
features.details: Both Windows desktop shells expose a notification-area tray menu for opening Marktis, opening the detected local Roblox settings location, launching Roblox through roblox://, restoring managed settings after an explicit confirmation, or quitting. Closing the window hides it to the tray while the app remains running. The shared Main page also has an equivalent in-app quick-action drawer.

features.name: Offline desktop troubleshooting guide
features.details: A bundled local decision guide covers Roblox detection, local settings not appearing to apply, manual FPS/ping readings, restoring managed settings, and WireGuard setup. It makes no network requests or automatic changes.

features.name: Optional Electron Windows desktop client
features.details: Optional Electron Windows desktop build for Marktis Optimizer, using the same distinct local desktop UI and narrow IPC bridge as Tauri. It includes read-only device inventory and Version Garden, safe rendering presets, the Tuning Lab, manual-only Benchmark Storyboard, in-app Quick Action Tray, offline troubleshooting, on-device name-only process alerts, standard roblox:// launch, and the same reversible settings boundary. The optional website TCP probe runs only on request and is not game-server ping. The shared UI bundles local anime themes and a Max performance profile.

features.name: User-controlled WireGuard provider tunnel
features.status: Implemented in Rust + Tauri and Electron Windows desktop apps
features.details: The user imports a provider-supplied .conf profile and must install the official WireGuard for Windows client. The desktop apps protect the local profile with machine-scope DPAPI, block custom command hooks, and require confirmation plus administrator approval for service changes. Provider AllowedIPs/DNS determine routing; default routes can carry all internet traffic and trigger WireGuard firewall behavior. No VPN service, server, credentials, or lower-ping guarantee is provided.

features.name: Guided x64 Windows setup wizards
features.details: Configures separate NSIS setup wizards for the Rust + Tauri and Electron apps. Both installers create Start Menu shortcuts and register Windows uninstallers; the Tauri wizard offers a Desktop shortcut option, and the Electron wizard creates a Desktop shortcut. Both can launch the app after setup; no batch launcher is required. The new distribution stops staging the old portable Rust x64 executable.

features.name: Read-only local device and storage inventory
features.details: The System tab uses a fixed PowerShell/WMI query to show manufacturer/model and device type, CPU, RAM, graphics adapters, physical drives, and logical-volume free space. The snapshot is read-only, remains in the UI, does not query serial numbers, is not saved by the app, and is not uploaded.

features.name: Windows Advanced Graphics settings shortcut
features.details: The System tab opens the fixed Windows Advanced Graphics settings page so the user can choose a preferred GPU for Roblox. It does not toggle HAGS, change drivers, or write system settings.

features.name: Automatic cache cleaners and system/network/game-file tweaks
features.details: The app does not automatically delete Roblox cache/logs or %TEMP% files, modify fullscreen/CPU-priority registry values, clear standby memory, or force System Restore points. It does not offer app-controlled DNS/MTU tuning, route/IP filtering, Roblox traffic optimization, or asset replacement. The separate user-configured WireGuard tunnel follows only the provider's DNS/routes after confirmation. The optimizer remains focused on allowlisted local ClientAppSettings.json settings with timestamped backups.

features.name: Optional Roblox website TCP connection-time check
features.details: A user-triggered TCP handshake to www.roblox.com:443 shows website connection time only. It sends no application payload or account/game data, but the endpoint sees the normal network connection and source IP. It is not ping to a Roblox game server.

features.name: Read actual in-game FPS and experience ping
features.details: The app does not read Roblox memory, process telemetry, or live game statistics. Use Roblox Performance Stats (Shift+F5) for actual in-game FPS and server ping. The experimental legacy FPS value is only a request, not a measurement.

features.name: Local anime desktop theme gallery
features.details: The standalone desktop UI bundles original anime-inspired fan-art backgrounds that stay local and apply a matching accent color. Selecting a theme changes only the app appearance, not Roblox content or graphics settings. Ten images are currently bundled; thirty requested images remain pending generation.
